number-of-possible-sets-of-closing-branc.statement: Count the subsets of branches you can close so every remaining pair is within maxDistance.

minimum-cost-to-convert-string-i.statement: Characters can be changed via given rules at given costs. Return the minimum cost to turn source into target, or -1.

minimum-cost-to-convert-string-ii.statement: Like Convert String I, but the rules replace whole substrings, and chosen substrings must be disjoint or identical.

count-the-number-of-houses-at-a-certain-.statement: Houses on a line plus one extra road between x and y. For each k, count the house pairs at shortest distance k.
The same as part I, but n is up to 10^5.
